query:
SELECT 
  cc.classificacao,
  SUM(CAST(lc.valor AS DECIMAL(15,2))) as total,
  COUNT(*) as qtd
FROM lancamento_custo lc
JOIN conta_custo cc ON cc.id = lc.contaCustoId
WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = 60001
GROUP BY cc.classificacao;
